cases.summary: Unhealthy SSo and events on Fresh 1.42.2
cases.description:
## Describe the Bug

I'm installing a fresh instance on an OpenSUSE 15.3 server. The SSO and the events containers seem to have issues as per the attached logs.

## Steps To Reproduce

1. Start from a fresh install on OpenSUSE 15.3
2. ./bitwarden.sh start
3. Visit the nginx port to confirm the instance has not started


## Expected Result

Bitwarden up and running

## Actual Result

evidence.eventual_fix_problem_statement:
Fix SQL Connection String

- When the `global.override.env` file is read/saved any double quotes need to be escaped for the SQL Connection String.  This is due to quotes being added if there are spaces in the database name.

One issue that could possibly come up is if someone used our last release to create a new self-hosted instance and they try to upgrade to the new release that contains this fix.  This will break on update due to the connection string being surrounded by single-quotes.  The fix will be updating the connection string to be surrounded by double-quotes and escaping any double-quotes inside of the string.

Closes #1546
